_comment: Agent orchestrator config. NO SECRETS HERE (broker keys / bot token come from the environment / .env). mode=paper + block_mode=mock is the safe default that runs end-to-end with no other block wired. Flip blocks.<name>.mode to 'live' as each block lands; live trading additionally requires enable_live=true AND mode=live.

backend._comment: mode=live calls backend.ingest/integrity/store in-process. Keep mock until data/raw is seeded (a clean clone has no candles -> integrity HALTs).

sleeve._comment: mode=live shells out to ml/scripts/predict_dividend_sleeve.py --out - (needs data/raw panels). Override command to pin an interpreter, e.g. ["ml/.venv-win/Scripts/python.exe", "ml/scripts/predict_dividend_sleeve.py"].

execution._comment: mode=live drives the REAL execution ExecutionEngine (paper broker sim) in-process: discipline -12/-2, lot rounding, dup-ledger, audit. State lands in the backed-up data tree. live trading still needs allow_live + EXECUTION_ALLOW_LIVE=1.

llm._comment: EOD step 2: refresh the upcoming-dividend feed BEFORE the sleeve. Best-effort (failure alerts, never blocks). Recommended: the canonical one-shot refresh CLI, with pass_as_of=true so the orchestrator appends --as-of <trade_date> (no-lookahead). e.g. refresh_cmd=["ml/.venv-win/Scripts/python.exe", "llm/scripts/refresh_dividend_feed.py"], pass_as_of=true.
